description: List published product permalink IDs and their updated_at freshness. Use the IDs to request individual products. Over HTTP, omitting limit returns the full published index, while the MCP tool lianex_products returns one page of 50; otherwise offset, page_size and has_more describe the page. ignored lists unusable paging parameters. Results can change between requests. Cache-only.

limit.description: How many permalinks to return, clamped to 50. Over HTTP, omitting it returns the whole index (the sitemap's own source, never truncated by default). The MCP tool lianex_products returns 50 per call when it is omitted; continue with offset while has_more is true.

offset.description: How many permalinks to skip. Unusable values are ignored and named in `ignored`; a negative value is clamped to 0.

name: lianex_products
title: The published product-permalink index
